name: core-binding factor subunit beta
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: CBFB encodes core-binding factor subunit beta. Annotated molecular activities include transcription coactivator activity and sequence-specific DNA binding. It participates in transcription by RNA polymerase II and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to cleidocranial dysplasia 2 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Myeloid sarcoma; Acute myeloid leukemia. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
